concerns.text: FR-002 (Pushshift fetch) and FR-003 (User matching) lack valid task coverage due to circular dependencies. T013 (Fetch Pushshift) depends on T014 (Match Users) and T012.6 (Window Calc), but T014/T012.6 require Pushshift data to function. The plan (Phase 1) correctly orders Fetch -> Match, but tasks enforce the reverse, blocking execution.

FR-002 (Pushshift fetch) and FR-006 (Bootstrap/Retry) lack coverage for infrastructure. T006 (Env Config), T007 (Data Validation), and T008 (Retry Policy) are marked rejected/failed in the re-plan section, yet T013 and T027 explicitly depend on them. Without these tasks, the pipeline cannot handle rate limits or validate data.

FR-003 (User Matching) is unimplemented. T014 is marked as failed/rejected, yet it is the hard prerequisite for T013 (Fetch Pushshift) and T012.6. The matching logic is missing, creating a complete blockage for the data pipeline.

SC-002 (R² gain threshold) and SC-001 (Match rate) coverage is ambiguous. T029 states 'Do NOT halt execution if R² gain < 0.05', but the spec's Edge Cases and T015 require halting on 'Power Insufficient' (N < 500 or match rate < 80%). The task fails to cover the mandatory halt condition for sample size/match rate, conflicting with the spec.

T014 description mentions 'no salt' for hashing. While this satisfies FR-003's 'SHA-256 hashed usernames', it lacks an explicit constraint to ensure raw usernames are never logged or persisted transiently, risking a PII leak (Constitution Principle III). The task description should explicitly forbid logging raw usernames.
